title: Spectrogram UI (Audacity-style) on the SpectrumCore worker

decisions.text: Architecture: LIVE worker over WebSocket. The bun server spawns/manages a long-lived SpectrumCoreFftwWorkerProbe and proxies JSON; the UI requests tiles on demand by (timeStart,timeEnd,zoom) over the overview pyramid. Reuses the worker's W2/W3 (pyramid + budgeted cache).

Code location: UI in GnauralCore/ui (source of truth; MindWaveCore re-exports). Server integration in GnauralCore/server (audio domain) wired through MindWaveCore/server (bun, the runtime host). Plan + ledger live here in GnauralCore/docs/spectrogram-ui/.
Worker binary: DEV-ONLY for now. The server locates SpectrumCoreFftwWorkerProbe.exe via config/ENV (run manually in dev); packaging/distribution deferred to a later step.

The UI settings panel must surface the FULL SpectrumCore capability set (post Audacity-parity): fscale lin/log/mel/bark/erb/period; data magnitude/phase/uphase/reassign/pitch; scale lin/sqrt/cbrt/log/4thrt/5thrt; window + zero-padding; the full win_func list incl. gauss25/35/45; gain/frequencyGain/drange/limit/saturation; start/stop; mode combined/separate; channel; palette + color gain. Coverage is an acceptance criterion (U4.3).

Render split: fetch LINEAR-magnitude tiles from the worker and apply scale/gain/drange/limit/saturation/palette in the renderer (live, no re-analysis). Re-analysis (worker reconfigure) is needed only for window/hop/overlap/win_func/data/fscale/zero-padding/mode/channel/start/stop. Finalized in U4.2.

Time slider: reuse the existing schedule-player time slider/scrubber IF it provides the needed seek + zoom/pan for spectrogram mode; otherwise adapt or build one styled to match. U3.2 includes the evaluation. (GnauralTransportControls.vue is play/pause/export only, not a scrubber.)
Process: plan doc + JSON ledger; per-step atomic commits prefixed with the step id; NO push (origin left to the user); pause at phase boundaries for review.

Gates: vue-tsc typecheck + lint; bun contract tests for the server worker-bridge (spawn on a fixture; assert tile/point/area shapes; reconfigure; crash-restart) as the PRIMARY automated gate; vitest unit tests for composable/store logic; visual parity vs Audacity/ffmpeg references is manual / non-blocking.
Prerequisite met: the SpectrumCore Audacity full-parity backend (../../../SpectrumCore/spec/audacity-parity-plan.md) is complete; this plan consumes it.

steps.title: Plan & ledger
steps.verify: ledger JSON parses; dependsOn DAG acyclic; plan + ledger committed
evidence: Authored the Spectrogram UI plan + ledger after exploring the stack (Quasar/Vue3 UI in GnauralCore/ui re-exported into MindWave; bun server with WS handlers; existing placeholder SpectrogramView.vue computing Goertzel client-side; SpectrumCore worker exposes open-analysis/get-tile(time,zoom)/point-query/area-query/export-matrix).
Committed as U0.1 (single commit, no push).

steps.title: WS spectrogram protocol + bridge skeleton + smoke harness
steps.verify: additive WS message types defined (TS); bridge skeleton spawns the worker on a fixture, opens an analysis, requests one tile, asserts shape; bun smoke test green
evidence: Additive WS protocol in SharedPasCore/ts/spectrogram-protocol.ts (no existing type touched): camelCase discriminated unions SpectrogramClientMessage (open/reconfigure/get-tile/point-query/area-query/close) + SpectrogramServerMessage (opened/reconfigured/tile/point/area/closed/error) + payload shapes (SpectrogramAnalysisInfo/Tile/TileFrame/PointResult/AreaResult), mirroring the worker contract. Re-exported via GnauralCore/server/protocol.ts.

GnauralCore/server/spectrogram-bridge.ts skeleton: resolveSpectrogramWorkerExe (SPECTRUMCORE_WORKER_EXE env, else dev fallback ../../SpectrumCore/build/win64/SpectrumCoreFftwWorkerProbe.exe, DU3); spawnSpectrogramWorker (Bun.spawn, NDJSON line reader, FIFO req/resp correlation -- U1.1 will add id-correlation/timeout/restart); smokeOpenAndGetTile (open-analysis -> get-tile -> close, always closes).

bun smoke spectrogram-bridge.test.ts: spawns the real worker on tests/fixtures/sine440_1s_mono_44k.wav, asserts open shape (sampleRate/frameCount/binCount) + tile shape (frames.length==emittedFrameCount, binFrequenciesHz.length==binCount, frame bins.length==binCount). `bun test` -> 2 pass / 0 fail / 14 expect (251ms). skipIf(exe||fixture missing) for portability (DU3 dev-only).

Gates: bun smoke green; tsc --noEmit (MindWave tsconfig, which includes GnauralCore/server) -> exit 0, 0 errors. Stale SpectrumCore cli/spec/ doc links repointed to spec/ after the SpectrumCore restructure.
Two repos (DU2): SharedPasCore commit (protocol types) + GnauralCore commit (bridge/test/re-export/plan+ledger). No push.

steps.title: Worker process manager (spawn / NDJSON / lifecycle)
steps.verify: Bun.spawn of the worker (exe path from config/ENV); newline-delimited JSON framing; request/response correlation; timeout + crash-restart; clean shutdown. Unit/bun test for framing + restart

steps.title: Audio source resolution (WAV for the worker)
steps.verify: resolve the server-side WAV path for audio.selectedPath; convert non-WAV to a temp WAV via the existing export pipeline; cache + cleanup. Test: open-analysis succeeds for a non-WAV source

steps.title: WS endpoints (open / reconfigure / get-tile / point / area / close)
steps.verify: per-connection session routes UI WS messages to the worker and streams responses; backpressure-safe. bun contract test (open -> get-tile -> point-query -> area-query -> reconfigure -> close) green

steps.title: useSpectrogram composable (tile fetch + client cache)
steps.verify: opens an analysis over WS; requests tiles for the visible (time-range, zoom); client-side tile cache; debounced refetch on view change; cancellation. vitest unit for the cache/refetch logic

steps.title: Canvas tile renderer (replace the Goertzel placeholder)
steps.verify: draw worker tiles (float -> palette -> ImageData) on canvas; frequency axis honours fscale (lin/log/mel/bark/erb/period via binFrequenciesHz); replaces the client-side Goertzel path; renders a fixture end-to-end

steps.title: Palettes + client-side value transform
steps.verify: scale/gain/drange/limit/saturation/palette + color gain applied in the renderer on linear tiles (live, no refetch); palettes mirror the backend for parity; updates without re-analysis

steps.title: Frequency axis + time ruler (chrome)
steps.verify: frequency axis labels honour fscale; time ruler labels; legend/units. The chrome SpectrumCore intentionally omitted is rendered here

steps.title: Time slider + zoom/pan
steps.verify: evaluate the schedule-player time slider for reuse (DU6); reuse or adapt; zoom/pan over time drives get-tile by (timeStart,timeEnd,zoom) across pyramid tiers; smooth at multiple zooms

steps.title: Playhead sync with audio playback (optional)
steps.verify: a playhead overlay tracks the transport position during playback; seeking via the slider updates playback if wired. Non-blocking if transport integration is out of reach

steps.title: Full parameter panel (all backend capabilities)
steps.verify: panel exposes window, zero-padding, hop/overlap, win_func (full incl. gauss25/35/45), data (magnitude/phase/uphase/reassign/pitch), scale family, fscale (lin/log/mel/bark/erb/period), start/stop, gain, frequencyGain, drange, limit, saturation, mode, channel, palette + color gain; bound to a pinia store

steps.title: Apply semantics (render-only vs reconfigure) + persistence
steps.verify: render-only params (scale/gain/drange/limit/saturation/palette) update without refetch; reconfigure params (window/hop/overlap/win_func/data/fscale/zero-padding/mode/channel/start/stop) trigger re-analysis; settings persist (localStorage)

steps.title: Capability-coverage check + Audacity/ffmpeg presets
steps.verify: every SpectrumCore option (DU4) reachable from the UI (coverage matrix doc + a test asserting the option set); Audacity-default and ffmpeg-showspectrumpic-default presets selectable

steps.title: Hover readout (time / frequency / intensity)
steps.verify: hovering shows time/frequency/intensity via worker point-query (throttled); readout matches the rendered cell

steps.title: Area selection -> area-query overlay
steps.verify: drag-select a time/frequency region -> worker area-query -> peak/mean stats overlay; selection maps correctly under zoom/pan and fscale

steps.title: i18n / a11y / states / perf + final acceptance
steps.verify: i18n strings; a11y (canvas aria, keyboard); loading/empty/error states; perf pass (tile cache sizing, request cancellation); vue-tsc + lint + bun contract + vitest all green; set plan status complete

log.note: Spectrogram UI plan + ledger created. Architecture: live SpectrumCore worker over WebSocket via the bun server (DU1); UI in GnauralCore/ui re-exported to MindWave (DU2); worker exe dev-only via config/ENV (DU3); UI must surface the full post-Audacity-parity capability set (DU4); render-only vs reconfigure split (DU5). Prerequisite (Audacity full-parity backend) complete.

Additive WS spectrogram protocol (SharedPasCore/ts/spectrogram-protocol.ts, re-exported) + spectrogram-bridge.ts skeleton (spawn worker, NDJSON FIFO, open->get-tile->close) + bun smoke (real worker on sine440 fixture: 2 pass/0 fail/14 expect) + tsc 0 errors. Stale cli/spec/ doc links repointed to spec/ post-restructure. Phase 0 complete; next U1.1 (process manager: id-correlation, timeout, crash-restart).
